Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring local governments and public utilities to consult when relocating water/sewer facilities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the coordination of water and sewer systemutilities; amending RCW 36.55.060; and adding a new section to chapter35.21 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 35.21 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Cities shall, in the predesign phase of construction projectsinvolving relocation of sewer and/or water facilities, consult withpublic utilities operating water/sewer systems in order to coordinatedesign.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 36.55.060 and 1963 c 4 s 36.55.060 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any person constructing or operating any utility on or along acounty road shall be liable to the county for all necessary expenseincurred in restoring the county road to a suitable condition fortravel. (2) No franchise shall be granted for a period of longer than fiftyyears. p. 1 SHB 1228 (3) No exclusive franchise or privilege shall be granted. (4) The facilities of the holder of any such franchise shall beremoved at the expense of the holder thereof, to some other location onsuch county road in the event it is to be constructed, altered, orimproved or becomes a primary state highway and such removal isreasonably necessary for the construction, alteration, or improvementthereof. (5) Counties shall, in the predesign phase of construction projectsinvolving relocation of sewer and/or water facilities, consult withpublic utilities operating water/sewer systems in order to coordinatedesign.
